title: Components of a w-local space
statement:
Let $T$ be a spectral space whose set $T^c$ of closed points is closed.

1. $T^c$, with the subspace topology, is profinite.
2. If every point of $T$ specializes to exactly one closed point, then the map
   $r\colon T\to T^c$ sending a point to its closed specialization is a continuous
   retraction; the connected components of $T$ are the fibres
   $r^{-1}(c)=\{\text{generalizations of }c\}$, $c\in T^c$; and the composite
   $T^c\hookrightarrow T\to\pi_0(T)$ is a homeomorphism; in particular $\pi_0(T)$ is profinite.
3. Conversely, if every connected component of $T$ contains exactly one closed point, then
   every point of $T$ specializes to exactly one closed point. Hence the definition of
   w-local in [sk-def-pe-wlocal] agrees with [def-weil-pbc-w-local].
4. For $T=\operatorname{Spec}R$ w-local and $\mathfrak m\in T^c$, the component of
   $\mathfrak m$ is the image of $\operatorname{Spec}R_{\mathfrak m}\to\operatorname{Spec}R$.

proof.text: Apply spectral_closed_subspace to the closed locus S of closed points. The subtype has T1Space by WLocalSpace.t1Space_closedPoints, without assuming WLocalSpace T. The already proved SpectralSpace.totallySeparatedSpace instance (Stacks 0905) gives total separation of S. Consequently S is compact Hausdorff and totally disconnected. This reuses the source-library proof of the former constructible-closure steps.

For each x, exists_isClosed_specializes applies the compact T0 closed-point theorem to closure {x}, producing a closed specialization c. Specializes.connectedComponents_mk_eq identifies the components of x and c: a singleton closure is connected.

When closed specializations are unique, construct the WLocalSpace instance using that uniqueness and closedness of S. Apply the existing closed-points/components homeomorphism e. Define r = e.symm composed with the component quotient. It is continuous and fixes S. For a closed specialization c of x, specialization preserves the component quotient; injectivity of e gives r(x)=c.

For closed c, r(x)=c iff the component classes of x and c agree, hence the fibre is the component. For x in that component choose its closed specialization d from step 2; injectivity on closed points gives d=c. Conversely specialization gives equal components. Thus the component equals the generalizations of c. Transport all three profinite properties through e.

If each component contains a unique closed point, a closed specialization from step 2 lies there, and any other closed specialization lies there too, giving uniqueness. Conversely the homeomorphism injects closed points into components and closed-point existence gives surjectivity. These arguments construct the space-level WLocalSpace equivalence with closedness retained, and unfolding IsWLocalRing gives the affine-ring equivalence.

A maximal ideal m determines a closed spectrum point. Apply the component/generalization identity from step 4. PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_range for Localization.AtPrime m gives exactly the primes disjoint from m.primeCompl. Such disjointness is equivalent to containment in m, by taking complements; PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes identifies that containment with specialization to m. This proves the last clause.

lean.statement: theorem spectralSpace_closedPoints_components (T : Type u) [TopologicalSpace T] [SpectralSpace T] (hclosed : IsClosed (closedPoints T)) : (CompactSpace (closedPoints T) ∧ T2Space (closedPoints T) ∧ TotallyDisconnectedSpace (closedPoints T)) ∧ ((∀ x : T, ∃! c : closedPoints T, x ⤳ c.val) → (∃ r : T → closedPoints T, Continuous r ∧ (∀ x : T, x ⤳ (r x).val) ∧ (∀ c : closedPoints T, r c.val = c) ∧ ∀ c : closedPoints T, r ⁻¹' {c} = connectedComponent c.val ∧ connectedComponent c.val = {x : T | x ⤳ c.val}) ∧ IsHomeomorph (ConnectedComponents.mk ∘ (Subtype.val : closedPoints T → T)) ∧ CompactSpace (ConnectedComponents T) ∧ T2Space (ConnectedComponents T) ∧ TotallyDisconnectedSpace (ConnectedComponents T)) ∧ ((∀ x : T, ∃! c : closedPoints T, c.val ∈ connectedComponent x) → ∀ x : T, ∃! c : closedPoints T, x ⤳ c.val) ∧ (WLocalSpace T ↔ ∀ x : T, ∃! c : closedPoints T, c.val ∈ connectedComponent x) ∧ (∀ (R : Type v) [CommRing R], IsWLocalRing R ↔ IsClosed (closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum R)) ∧ ∀ x : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃! c : closedPoints (PrimeSpectrum R), c.val ∈ connectedComponent x) ∧ (∀ (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsWLocalRing R] (m : Ideal R) [m.IsMaximal], connectedComponent (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R) = Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime m))))
